source_text: 洞庭湖位于湖南省东北部，面积很大，但湖水很浅。洞庭湖是长江的蓄洪池，湖的大校很大程度 上取决于季节变化。湖北和湖南两省因其与湖的相对位置而得名，湖北意为“湖的北边”，而湖南则为 “湖的南边”。洞庭湖作为龙舟赛的发源地，在中国文化中享有盛名。据说龙舟赛始于洞庭湖东岸。为 的是搜寻楚国爱国诗人屈原的遗体。龙舟赛与洞庭湖及周边的美景，每年都吸引着成千上万来自全国 和世界各地的游客。
reference_translation: Located in the northeastern part of Hunan Province, Dongting Lake is large in area but shallow in depth. It serves as a flood-storage reservoir for the Yangtze River, and its size largely depends on seasonal changes. The names of Hubei and Hunan provinces are derived from their relative positions to the lake. "Hubei" means "north of the lake", while "Hunan" means "south of the lake". As the birthplace of the dragon-boat race, Dongting Lake enjoys great fame in Chinese culture. It is said that the dragon-boat race originated on the eastern shore of Dongting Lake to search for the body of Qu Yuan, a patriotic poet of the Chu State. The dragon-boat race, combined with the beautiful scenery around Dongting Lake, attracts thousands of tourists from across China and the world every year.
